description: This file defines syntax highlighting mode for Rust language in the CodeMirror code editor. It specifies regex-based tokenization rules for Rust syntax elements such as strings, numbers, keywords, comments, and other language constructs.

methods.name: CodeMirror.defineSimpleMode
methods.description: Defines a syntax highlighting mode named 'rust' with specific tokenization rules.

methods.name: CodeMirror.defineMIME
methods.description: Associates MIME types 'text/x-rustsrc' and 'text/rust' with the Rust mode.
